title: Every Flutter app on your phone
sub: Detected from APK contents, not a manifest flag. 33 of 306 installed apps here, with no root and no PC.

title: A graded report, with the reason
sub: Severity counts, artifact facts and the full base-APK SHA-256. The grade always states why it was awarded.

title: Evidence, not guesswork
sub: Every finding names the pattern that matched and the artifact it came from. A match is a lead, not proof of exploitability.

title: See the SDKs and AI providers
sub: This one app carried markers for 32 services, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek and OpenRouter.

title: You decide what it can do
sub: Consent, secret reveal, sensitive exports, scan history and deletion are switches, not promises.

title: Offline by design
sub: No INTERNET permission, so nothing can leave the phone. The full policy ships inside the app.
